odia: ଚିତ୍ତ ଯେବେ ଦୃଢ଼, ତେବେ ଦାରୀ ସାହିରେ ଘର
title: Resolve and a neighbourhood’s stigma
literal_meaning: If the mind is firm, then a home even in the sex workers’ quarter.
explanation: The contrast makes firmness of mind stand against a stigmatized address. The source defines the quarter but gives no account of its residents’ conduct. Our critical reading separates personal resolve from that inherited suspicion: where someone lives cannot establish their worth. This challenge to the stigma is our response, not a counter-moral supplied by the saying.
meaning_odia: ମନର ଦୃଢ଼ତା ସାମ୍ନାରେ ଏଠି ଏକ କଳଙ୍କିତ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଠିକଣା ରଖାଯାଇଛି। ଉତ୍ସ ସାହିର ଅର୍ଥ ଦିଏ, ବାସିନ୍ଦାଙ୍କ ଆଚରଣର ବିବରଣୀ ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପଢ଼ା ମନର ଦୃଢ଼ତାକୁ ସେହି ସନ୍ଦେହଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ: ଠିକଣାରୁ ମଣିଷର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଜଣାଯାଏନାହିଁ। କଳଙ୍କକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରିବା ଆମର ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା, କଥାଟି ଦେଇଥିବା ଓଲଟା ନୀତି ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Our critical reading distinguishes resolve from prejudice about an address.
odia_summary: ମନର ଦୃଢ଼ତାକୁ ଠିକଣାର ପୂର୍ବଧାରଣାଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା କରିବା।
usage_example: Original imagined example: In a reading group, a participant quotes the line as praise of resolve. Another asks why the neighbourhood must carry suspicion in the first place. They discuss the contrast without judging its residents. This is an invented critical conversation, not collected traditional usage.
cultural_context: Historical derogatory naming remains in the exact witness. No named neighbourhood, universal community trait, documented incident or contemporary sex-work condition is inferred.
